root_cause.text: The `rxrpc_preparse_xdr_yfs_rxgk()` function in `net/rxrpc/key.c` fails to deallocate the dynamically allocated `token->rxgk` structure when error handling branches to the `reject_token:` cleanup label, resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces `kfree(token->rxgk);` at the `reject_token:` label in `net/rxrpc/key.c`, correcting the omission described in the CVE where memory attached to `token->rxgk` is leaked in error paths following its allocation.
